title: An undo pressed within a minute of the turn still reloads the site preview; the turn's own late reload request is still absorbed
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-968-undo-preview-reload.mjs
S2: Read its ok / not ok lines.
expect: 'an undo inside the absorb window reloads the page' passes.
'a plain request inside the same window is still absorbed' passes.
'the absorb slot survives an undo' passes.
The at-work, hidden-tab and open-comment-box undo tests pass.
evidence: Measured on cowork.tracy.site 06/10/2026 (tbaudit0930): Undo pressed ~60 s after the turn left the preview on the old heading while the site was undone (apply.revert ok); an Undo pressed 78 s after reloaded it. ABSORB_MS is 60 000.
fence: The reducer's absorb slot is for the turn's own duplicate request only; a request marked fresh (mode 'undo') reloads and leaves the slot in place.
